title: Dead Letter
caption: Solo piano, dark and sparse, film noir mood. A slow, lonely melody with bluesy inflections and long silences, low bass notes left to ring with the sustain pedal, a slightly worn upright piano in an empty room. Bleak, haunted, three in the morning. Intimate close recording with natural room reverb. No vocals, no other instruments.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
